Welcome to the Communication Primer

This site introduces non-technical readers to major communication theory schools and shows how each lens can clarify modern communication problems shaped by artificial intelligence.

This is starter text you can replace with your own analysis, examples, and references. The project is designed to make everyday communication breakdowns visible through practical theory tools.

How to Use This Site

Each subpage frames one shared communication problem through a different theoretical lens. Together, they move from transmission and meaning to power, interpretation, and practical action.

  • Read one lens at a time to compare what each framework reveals.
  • Track what changes when AI systems mediate messages.
  • Use the final guidance page to translate insights into action.
